title: Promote and roll back recipes via an immutable version pointer
narrative: Recipe execution policies must be versioned, testable, replaceable artifacts with a reversible promotion pointer — not only class version fields and demotion stamps. Incubation stamps exist in `fangore_insp_template_incubation`. Tracks MH-SR-01[^insp-sr-01].
implementation: GraphTemplate.version/status/fingerprints and demotion. Desired: immutable version artifacts with active promotion pointer and rollback target.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-SR-01, coverage partial, adjacent_ok, probes_ok with typed surface probes encoding the current product delta.
